question: Can retaining current decode experts during mixed MoE expert-group execution improve subsequent paging and complete requests after accounting for extra groups?
basis: Ordinary release8 reduced complete wall about9%; it saved7.927GB remaining prefill but increased subsequent decode by0.365GB, with97/112 subsequent entry-cache sets changing. Current-layer minimum copies does not determine future cost.
evidence_ceiling: Single GPU OLMoE artificial fixed per-layer cap24; same native BF16/Triton, KV1GiB; no method novelty/quality/SLO or oversized-model claim.
baseline: All performance arms use old-completion release8; existing resident-first expert grouping is none mode.

modes.frequency: protect the |decode union| most frequent experts in current actual top-k rows; expert-ID tie; unconstrained resident intersection
modes.decode: protect exact current decode-row expert union
modes.matched_hash: deterministic fixed-salt selection with same protected count and entry-resident overlap as decode; retain chance overlap and never tune salt

eligibility: Verified full actual row identity including prompt length; both prefill and decode rows; 0<decode union size<cap. Else unchanged ordinary execution with recorded reason.
algorithm: Execute every entry-resident active expert first, fill available slots with protected missing first. Later ensure loaded protection plus new unexecuted experts, but each kernel map only includes execute set. Every entry miss copied once; retain P at layer end.
invariants: no future route or request state used
current layer loaded experts exactly entry misses
scratch/KV/weight allocations unchanged; peak/activation/cpu overhead measured
qualified_fields: group.required_experts remains compute experts; ensure_experts and protected_after are separate. Repeated protection touches refresh LRU and stats_hits; do not count touches as independent hit gains.

qualification.reference: First actually applied cross-group protection mixed call in the entire standalone measurement run (one layer only, not per-layer coverage); clone every valid row x/topk IDs/weights before action and compare full native weights. Prefix calls must not consume validation slot; no applied call is a failed qualification.
qualification.failure: Invalid mapping/state or nonfinite results stop for diagnosis. allclose/bitwise are diagnostic and not universal quality guarantees.

performance.reset: Drained pager empty metadata/map then common warmups; preserve allocation and KV free queue

hypothesis_interpretation.decode_better_than_none_only: Could reflect generic retention; not enough to claim decode-identity value.
hypothesis_interpretation.decode_better_than_frequency_and_hash: Provisional identity-specific residual, still needs independent workload/regime confirmation and action-level prior-art review.
hypothesis_interpretation.copy_gain_but_time_loss: Measured grouping or observation/execution tax; no method gain, no problem-family rejection.
hypothesis_interpretation.no_copy_gain: Current decode set does not guide future residency here; preserve exact formulation boundary.

retention: All arms and qualification/failures retained, no post-hoc best repeat
remote_policy: Same authorized GPU, launch only when no foreign compute process; do not terminate unknown jobs or buy resources
coordination: Before a new run read experiments/admission_capacity/RESULT_LEDGER.md; this short mixed paging experiment uses none/frequency/decode/matched_hash, while the long resident rotation comparison separately requires native32/safe29/headroom32-fast/rotate32-c20. GPU occupancy checks leave records and abort on foreign process or query failure.
qualification_cpu_checks: 12 targeted CPU cases; additional11 GPU-guard mocks; py_compile and bash -n passed; no GPU qualification yet
